segments.an10.64:1.1: “Ye keci, bhikkhave, mayi aveccappasannā, sabbe te sotāpannā.
segments.an10.64:1.2: Tesaṃ sotāpannānaṃ pañcannaṃ idha niṭṭhā, pañcannaṃ idha vihāya niṭṭhā.
segments.an10.64:1.4: Sattakkhattuparamassa, kolaṃkolassa, ekabījissa, sakadāgāmissa, yo ca diṭṭheva dhamme arahā – imesaṃ pañcannaṃ idha niṭṭhā.
segments.an10.64:1.7: Antarāparinibbāyissa, upahaccaparinibbāyissa, asaṅkhāraparinibbāyissa, sasaṅkhāraparinibbāyissa, uddhaṃsotassa akaniṭṭhagāmino – imesaṃ pañcannaṃ idha vihāya niṭṭhā.
segments.an10.64:1.9: Ye keci, bhikkhave, mayi aveccappasannā sabbe te sotāpannā.
segments.an10.64:1.10: Tesaṃ sotāpannānaṃ imesaṃ pañcannaṃ idha niṭṭhā, imesaṃ pañcannaṃ idha vihāya niṭṭhā”ti.
